dialogues.speaker: Bahar
dialogues.text: Well done. You got all the answers correct.

choices.text: So, about the full truth behind this tale...

response.speaker: Bahar
response.text: Here is the full truth: Bahera took the keys to the office, and when his mentor sent him a letter to ask for them, he sent them in a letter back to the Akademiya.

response.speaker: Bahar
response.text: However, when his letter reached his Darshan, the staff member simply dropped it into Bahera's mentor's office through its letter slot.

response.speaker: Bahar
response.text: As such, both the office keys and the letter wound up stuck inside the locked office.

choices.text: So, about the full truth behind this tale...
